Phase 5 — Hydrogel Rheology and Printing-context Visualisations

Independent Phase 5 exploratory figures prepared from the audited hydrogel bioink evidence layer. Each visualisation preserves the distinction between measurement points, worksheets, and physical samples. The full set of 25 PNG figures is embedded in this single HTML file; no separate image folder is required.

Scientific interpretation: physical-sample and rheology-to-image links are not confirmed; the mPas token remains unresolved; the fixed-frequency oscillatory data must not be relabelled as frequency sweeps; these descriptive plots do not prove printability or supervised-model readiness.
Source data: Zhang et al., Zenodo record 19602891 (v0.0.2). The plots are exploratory derivatives of the source data. This self-contained copy is for local review; please confirm dataset reuse terms before public posting. Dataset DOI
